en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The large left image shows a very tall concrete telecommunications tower rising above trees, with a series of stacked circular observation or technical decks near the top and a long segmented antenna mast. The right side is split into two interior views of a modernist restaurant or café inside the tower, featuring curved mezzanines, sweeping staircases, large panoramic windows, potted plants, and neatly arranged tables and chairs.
